title: Sintel
description: A chance encounter. An unlikely friendship. Follow a young traveler into a breathtaking world in search of a dragon she once called her own. Directed by Colin Levy, this open animated short is a story of courage, loss, and the bonds that stay with us.

title: Big Buck Bunny
description: A gentle giant finds that even the most beautiful day can be interrupted by three mischievous woodland creatures. A playful, colorful animated short directed by Sacha Goedegebure.

title: Tears of Steel
description: In a future Amsterdam, a group of scientists and soldiers recreates a moment from the past in a last attempt to stop a robot uprising. A science-fiction short combining live action and visual effects, directed by Ian Hubert.

title: Elephants Dream
description: Two travelers explore a strange mechanical world, each seeing something very different in its winding corridors. Directed by Bassam Kurdali, Blender’s first open movie is a surreal journey through imagination and obsession.
